heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Do you test on real Android devices?
items.answer: Yes. Every build is tested on a range of real devices and Android versions.

items.question: Kotlin or Java?
items.answer: New projects use Kotlin. We also work with existing Java codebases.

items.question: Can you build the backend too?
items.answer: Yes. We build APIs, admin panels and databases alongside the app.

items.question: How long does android app development take?
items.answer: A focused app usually takes 8 to 12 weeks, while feature-rich apps with custom backends take 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
